scripts.check: bun run check:toolchain && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck --noEmit && bun run typecheck --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json && bun run typecheck -b frontend --noEmit && bun run lint && bun test scripts/check-toolchain.test.ts && bun run test:server && bun run test:frontend && bun run build && bunx wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run && bun run check:bundle
scripts.check:fast: bun run check:toolchain && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck --noEmit && bun run typecheck --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json && bun run typecheck -b frontend --noEmit && bun run lint
scripts.test: bun run test:server && bun run test:frontend
scripts.test:e2e:core: bun run build && playwright test -c playwright.core.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:remediation: bun run build && playwright test -c playwright.remediation.config.ts
scripts.ux:capture: bun run build && playwright test -c playwright.ux.config.ts
scripts.lighthouse:ci: bun run build && bun run scripts/lighthouse-ci.ts
scripts.db:migrate:cf: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply remindarr --remote
scripts.sentry:release:new: bunx sentry-cli releases new -p remindarr-cf -p remindarr-fe "$VERSION"
scripts.sentry:release:upload-maps: bunx sentry-cli sourcemaps inject frontend/dist && bunx sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --project remindarr-fe --release="$VERSION" frontend/dist
scripts.sentry:release:finalize: bunx sentry-cli releases set-commits "$VERSION" --auto && bunx sentry-cli releases finalize "$VERSION"
scripts.deploy:cf: bun run sentry:env-check && bun run db:migrate:cf && export VERSION=$(bunx sentry-cli releases propose-version) && export VITE_SENTRY_RELEASE="$VERSION" && bun run build && bun run sentry:release:new && bun run sentry:release:upload-maps && bun run prune:maps && bunx wrangler deploy --var SENTRY_RELEASE:"$VERSION" && bun run sentry:release:finalize
scripts.deploy:cf:version: bun run sentry:env-check && bun run db:migrate:cf && (bunx wrangler versions upload || bunx wrangler deploy)
